marine_institute.title: Marine Institute station
marine_institute.description: Choose the tide gauge station to track. Data comes from the Marine Institute's tide prediction service.

manual_station.title: Enter station name
manual_station.description: The station list couldn't be loaded from the Marine Institute. Enter the exact station name, for example: Dublin_Port.

harmonic.title: Local harmonic model
harmonic.description: Predicts tides locally from Moon/Sun position using a harmonic constituent model -- no network access needed. Works for any station, Ireland or UK, that you have harmonic constants for (see the README for where to source real ones). Enter one constituent per line as 'NAME AMPLITUDE_M PHASE_DEG', e.g. 'M2 1.90 137'.

data.label: Station name
data.datum_label: Datum (for your own reference, e.g. "Chart Datum")

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Marine Institute tide data service.
error.unknown_station: No tide predictions were found for that station. Check the spelling and try again.
error.invalid_constituents: Could not parse the harmonic constituents. Check the format: one 'NAME AMPLITUDE PHASE' per line, e.g. 'M2 1.90 137'.
